summary: Gate the dev merge queue. The CI Policy job runs make merge-queue-policy, which runs .github/scripts/merge_queue_policy.py. The script reads the live dev and main branch rules with gh api and the workflow files. It fails when dev has no merge queue, main has a merge queue, dev has classic required checks, dev has non-strict checks without a queue, or a required dev check has no merge_group producer. The lint job installs PyYAML and make lint-cover runs the new Python tests. A new ggshield workflow produces the required GitGuardian check on pull requests and merge groups. ADR 0007 and docs/CONTRIBUTING.md describe the queue. No Go package, import, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: The merge queue policy check is a new CI data flow. It reads the public branch rules of this repository from the GitHub API with the read-only workflow token. It sends no repository content and executes no candidate source beyond the checked-in script. ADR 0007 records the new merge_queue_policy boundary in the model. The ggshield workflow is not a modeled policy path. It sends the new commits to the GitGuardian API with the GITGUARDIAN_API_KEY secret. The other trust_changes entries restate the existing boundaries.
